name: AI Bots
author: Desvelao
description: Hosts can fill a room with AI players, choose their level and add single bots. The bots run inside the server or in the separate bot server.

config.label: Allow bots
config.description: Hosts may fill their room with bots and add bots.

config.label: Where the bots run
config.description: embedded: inside this server. external: the separate bot server plays them (it joins with the token).

config.label: Bot server token
config.description: Secret the bot server presents when it seats bots (its GAME_SERVER_BOT_TOKEN). Empty: only embedded bots.

config.label: Most embedded bots
config.description: Bots playing at the same time inside this server; 0 = by hardware profile (LOW_POWER 2, NORMAL 8, HIGH 16).

config.label: Decisions per second
config.description: How often an embedded bot decides; 0 = by hardware profile (LOW_POWER 10, NORMAL 20, HIGH 30). Lower is lighter on small machines.

config.label: Rooms with every game
config.description: never: no bots in a room that rotates through every game. always: bots join; every built-in game has an AI, so they only sit out the rounds of installed games that have none.

config.label: Custom playlists
config.description: any: bots join a playlist when they can play at least one of its games. all: only when they can play all of them.

config.label: Idle bots leave after
config.description: Seconds a bot may sit out (the room plays a game it has no AI for) before it leaves; 0 = never.

config.label: Bot names start with
config.description: Start of the bots' display names, like "Bot Hard" (up to 8 letters).

config.label: Management API
config.description: Serve the management API at /api/bots (admin only): bots, rooms, pause, settings. The dashboard needs it.

config.label: Dashboard
config.description: Serve the dashboard page at /plugins/bots/ (admin sign-in with the server token).

config.label: Change settings from the dashboard
config.description: Let an admin change the bot settings that apply here while the server runs.

config.label: Audit log
config.description: Keep a log of who changed what in the management API.

config.label: Match reports
config.description: Write a report of every bot match (files are written on the game loop: leave off on small machines).

config.label: Reports folder
config.description: Where the reports go; empty = a folder in the plugin's data folder.
